camel_example: aliyun farui POST /llm-9w5y60lseff0jiqm/data/textFile --region cn-hangzhou --header "Content-Type=application/x-www-form-urlencoded" --body TextFileName=测试文件.docx&TextFileUrl=https://xx.测试文件.docx&CreateTime=1714476549&ContractId=123&ClientToken=e9a93201-7e96-4dc1-9678-2832fc132d08 --version 2024-06-28 --force
description_en: Uploads a document to the contract review module. After the document is added, the system automatically starts parsing the file and returns the corresponding file ID for subsequent generation of review rules and review results. File parsing uses a queuing mechanism. If the queue is long, the file may take some time to be parsed
description_zh: 该接口用于将文档上传到合同审查模块中，添加成功之后，系统会自动启动文件的解析，并返回对应的文件ID用于后续生成审查规则和审查结果。文件解析有排队机制，如果队列较长，文件可能需要等待一段时间才能解析完成
